title: Partner Portal 1.0.0
summary: The first release: customers, firewalls, licenses, alerts and customer value reports in one portal, in English, Spanish and Portuguese.

items.title: Firewalls fleet page
items.body: One page lists the firewalls of all your customers, with their status, collected from each customer's controller.

items.title: Licenses and alerts overview
items.body: The dashboard shows licenses and the firewall alerts that need attention, with the menus Firewalls and Endpoints.

items.title: Alert notifications
items.body: Each organization chooses how to be warned about firewall alerts: e-mail, Telegram or a webhook, in the Notifications tab.

items.title: Customer value report
items.body: In Reports, a printable report per customer shows the protection, the licenses and the health of the firewalls.

items.title: Cloud Controller per customer
items.body: Every customer has its own controller space, opened with single sign-on from the portal.

items.title: Help that opens the right page
items.body: The help button opens the manual page of the screen you are on, at partnerdocs.nexwall.com.br.

items.title: Three languages
items.body: The whole portal, the welcome e-mails and the sign-in page are available in English, Spanish and Portuguese. New companies start in the language and country of the partner.

items.title: Cleaner menu
items.body: The menu was simplified and the names of Firewalls and Brand were aligned with the rest of the Nexwall products.
